name: @sos-2/local-bridge-contracts
description: SOS 2.0 Local Companion + Browser/IDE Bridge Acceptance Suites (Work Order P11): the acceptance proof of the local companion, the offline queueing/reconciliation discipline and the tier-4 bridges. Cloud-independence: a full cloud-body journey completes with ZERO companion presence (the P8 cloud journey re-run in a companion-absent world, pinned structurally by the file's import set). Offline queueing: local-only work orders queue while the device reports offline and run when it reconnects — nothing lost, nothing duplicated. Scope enforcement: out-of-scope file access and un-granted consequential operations are typed denials with truthful FAILED results through the public §9 contract behind the P5 broker. Reconnect reconciliation: event replay deduplication is exactly-once with gap-free sequence continuity (a gap is a typed violation). Provenance labelling: every local observation names its source + device identity; secrets never echo (output scans across all journeys). Bridges are adapters: no authority fields marshal across any bridge; a smuggled grant key is a typed violation naming the field. Honest statuses: NOT_YET_INSTALLED/NOT_YET_CONNECTED surfaces never fabricate connection evidence. Structural scans: zero new external dependencies (workspace:* + the existing toolchain only, checked against the base lockfile), offline determinism (no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env/ambient timers/child_process in the owned sources outside the documented apps/companion composition boundary), the repository's fixed vitest seed, and only merged + P11-owned workspace imports (unmerged siblings never referenced).
